# CDSKI - Clases de Ski y Snowboard en Chile (Full Details)

## About
CDSKI (Clases de Ski) is a professional ski and snowboard school based in Santiago, Chile. We provide lessons and guided experiences at the top ski resorts in the Chilean Andes: Valle Nevado, El Colorado, La Parva, and Farellones. Our expert instructors speak Spanish, English, and Portuguese, making us a top choice for international tourists visiting Chile during the Southern Hemisphere winter season (June to October).

## Business Information
- Official Name: CDSKI — Clases de Ski y Snowboard Chile

## Services

### 1. Group Ski Lessons
- Maximum 6 people per group
- Available for all levels: beginner, intermediate, advanced
- Half day (3 hours) and full day (5 hours) options
- Includes professional instruction at Valle Nevado, El Colorado, or La Parva

### 2. Private Ski Lessons
- 1-on-1 instruction with expert instructor
- Personalized to your level and goals
- Half day and full day options available
- Flexible scheduling

### 3. Private Snowboard Lessons
- 1-on-1 snowboard instruction
- All levels from first-timers to advanced riders
- Learn at your own pace with dedicated instructor

### 4. Heliski Experiences
- Access virgin snow and exclusive slopes in the Chilean Andes
- Professional mountain guides
- Premium adventure experience

### 5. Guided Snow Experience
- Perfect for families and groups new to snow
- Includes transportation, equipment, and professional accompaniment
- No prior experience needed

### 6. Corporate and School Group Events
- Custom packages for companies and schools
- Team building activities in the snow
- Group rates available

## Ski Resorts We Operate At

### Valle Nevado
- Altitude: 2,860 meters
- The largest ski resort in South America
- Less than 50 km from Santiago
- Modern facilities and varied terrain

### El Colorado
- One of Santiago's main ski resorts
- Close to Santiago, easy access
- Good for all levels

### La Parva
- Altitude: 2,750 meters
- Less than 50 km from Santiago
- Beautiful Andean scenery

### Farellones
- Closest snow area to Santiago
- Good for beginners and families
- Snow park and tubing available

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need prior experience to take lessons?
No! We have lessons for all levels, from absolute beginners to advanced. Our instructors adapt their teaching to your level.

### What do the all-inclusive packages include?
All-inclusive packages include ski resort access ticket, complete equipment (ski or snowboard, boots, and poles), and a 2-hour lesson with an expert instructor.

### Which ski resorts do you operate at?
We operate at Santiago's three main ski resorts: Valle Nevado (the largest in South America), El Colorado, and La Parva, all less than 50 km from Santiago.

### When is the ski season in Chile?
The ski season in Chile runs from June to October. Peak season includes weekends, holidays, and winter vacation (usually the last week of June and the first week of July).

### Do you offer lessons in English and Portuguese?
Yes! Our instructors speak Spanish, English, and Portuguese. We specialize in welcoming international tourists from the Americas, Europe, and Asia.

### How can I pay?
We accept Webpay Plus (Chilean and international debit/credit cards), Mercado Pago, PayPal, and bank transfer. Payment is 100% secure with instant confirmation.

### What age can children start taking lessons?
Children can start skiing from age 7. We have instructors specialized in children's teaching with fun and safe methodology.

### What should I bring to my ski lesson?
We recommend thermal layered clothing, waterproof gloves, hat, sunscreen, and sunglasses or goggles. Ski/snowboard equipment is included in our packages.

## Location and Access
Santiago, Chile is one of the few major cities in the world with world-class ski resorts just 60 km from downtown. The ski resorts in the Andes mountains are accessible via road from Santiago in approximately 1-2 hours, depending on conditions. CDSKI can arrange transportation as part of guided experiences.
